newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end lower following Chicago.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end lower following Chicago.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed lower across the board on Monday, reflecting weaker prices on Friday in Chicago, traders said.
Prices ranged from 30 to 80 yen per tonne lower, with benchmark May 1998 closing 50 yen down at 13,800 yen.
The day's estimated trade volume was 29,199 lots.
Active selling from local investors, stimulated by weaker prices in Chicago on Friday, pushed down the market from the outset, traders said.
On Friday, the CBOT corn market ended near a three-month low on prospects for good growing weather and technical weakness following Thursday's losses.
"Most traders were sidelined today, as the Chicago market is closed tonight," a brokerage house trader said.
The Chicago grain market is closed on Monday in observance of the U.S. Memorial Day holiday.
